font.reason: Neutral clean sans with a real heavy weight (variable 800 kept); matches the bold glow-on-dark background-layer look of the original system sans.

comps.translatedSummary: 22 Persian motion-design keywords (حرکت، چیدمان، دوربین، آبشاری، روانی، ضرب، کلیدفریم، محو، مقیاس، تبدیل، چرخش، پارالاکس، شفافیت، عمق، میان‌یابی، حلقه، فنر، تأخیر، ظهور، ترکیب، شبکه، محور) fly through the 3D tunnel.

rtlDecisions.why: Translated to idiomatic Persian terms of similar length (3-8 letters) so N=22, phase i/N and density/rhythm are unchanged.
Each word is one whole element; no letter splitting, so joining is intact. letterSpacing 0 (was 0.5px).
Hard-coded left offset assumed ~120px Latin words; replaced with inner translate(-50%,-50%) so any Persian word width is centred on its 3D anchor; outer translate3d/rotateZ untouched.

rtlDecisions.what: x/y scatter, golden angle, z travel, drift, rotateZ signs, perspective
rtlDecisions.why: Radially symmetric tunnel around the centred camera; no reading-direction meaning, mirroring a seeded random scatter adds nothing.

rtlDecisions.what: Centre glow, background radial gradient, blur and opacity curve

rtlDecisions.why: Motion fidelity; FLYING_WORDS_DURATION=180 unchanged, loop stays seamless.
fs() x1.1 for smaller Persian x-height; lineHeight FA_LH, direction rtl, unicode-bidi isolate.

rasterTextHandling: No raster/image assets; nothing to handle.
concerns: Weight 800 renders slightly lighter than the Latin original heavy system font; acceptable.
Words at near-camera end are huge/blurred by design (as in original).
